questions.question: What does Job make in chapter 31?
What covenant did Job say he had made?
options: With his friends, to keep their trust
With his eyes, not to look lustfully
With kings, to serve them faithfully
With his wealth, to give it all away
questions.answer: With his eyes, not to look lustfully

questions.question: Job invited God to weigh him in a just balance to know his integrity.
Job denied rejoicing in his _____'s ruin or exulting when evil befell him.
Job said if his land cried out against him, let _____ grow instead of wheat.
